details:
This kinda should solve and also introduce some challanges for implementation but in general i think this is important thing.
People will always add someting on their avatar and they care less about perfomance rating when they have their favorite hoodie and glasses or even multiple hairs on one avatar.
So i thinked about that and this could be solution, prop system in general. Should be sorted by Two parts. Always rendered and not always rendered.
Always rendered :
- Could still affect performance rank
- These props are part of that avatar
- They download with avatar
- Mostly things which are on by default at your avatar
- After disabling they hide but are still here
- There could be limited slots for them.. like 10 or 15 max.. but even less could be probably okay
Not always rendered:
- Many custom hairs
- Many custom objects
- Others users can take these object too
- Owner can disable them remotely trought QM
- They start downloading during spawning
- After disabling they just completely unrender
- There should be only unique props, for preventing spam spawning.
- Could be searchable if uploaded as public
And in safety setings could be option for disabling normal props... or 'always rendered props' which could be usefull if people actually uploaded their hoodies and items as props. Then this could give FPS boost without completely disabling or using fallback avatars.
Downside of this, there must be quick loading times for these props, and probably with more softer fps drop then during avatar loading.
But in future this can be also interesting to see what people will make as props.. because props don't need to be only avatar based.. they could be in the world, like Xbox Fridge without using Unity constrains as by now. And also you could be finally able borrow your baseball bat to friend. Safety settings need to be tweaked for the props.. but in the end it should work. 
Every prop need to be taged, and thes tags could be used for prop search in-game. I had this concept of prop system writen somewhere else but it was too much text so i simplified that. I hope general idea is stil here.
title: prop system
